from pathlib import Path
import shutil,subprocess,json
repo=Path('/home/lloydk/work/gma-benchmark');root=Path('/tmp/gma-m4-review');dest=root/'mutant'
if dest.exists():shutil.rmtree(dest)
dest.mkdir()
for name in ['src','tests','scripts']:shutil.copytree(repo/name,dest/name)
for name in ['bench.js','benchmark-workloads.js','package.json']:shutil.copy2(repo/name,dest/name)
(dest/'node_modules').symlink_to(repo/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
cases=[
 ('checked-wiring','bench.js','inGamutCheck ? bottossonLightnessChecked : bottossonLightness','bottossonLightness',['node','bench.js','--gamut','srgb','--validate-only','--in-gamut-check']),
 ('membership','src/rgb-convert.js','r >= 0 && r <= 1 && g >= 0 && g <= 1 && bl >= 0 && bl <= 1','r >= -1e-7 && r <= 1+1e-7 && g >= -1e-7 && g <= 1+1e-7 && bl >= -1e-7 && bl <= 1+1e-7',['node','--test','tests/bottosson.test.js','tests/edge-seeker-targets.test.js']),
 ('curvature','src/edge-seeker/makeLut.js','return { ...peakColor, curvature };','return { ...peakColor, curvature: curvature * (1+1e-6) };',['node','--test','tests/edge-seeker-targets.test.js']),
]
results=[]
for name,file,before,after,command in cases:
 p=dest/file;source=p.read_text();assert source.count(before)==1,(name,source.count(before));p.write_text(source.replace(before,after))
 try:
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=dest,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
  (root/f'mutation-{name}.log').write_text(result.stdout)
  results.append({'mutation':name,'command':command,'exitCode':result.returncode,'failures':[line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if any(x in line for x in ['✖','AssertionError','canonical bottosson'])][:15]})
  assert result.returncode!=0,name+' survived'
 finally:p.write_text(source)
(root/'mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
